name: Alicia
source:
Alicia is the maid android that Hiroki’s parents sent him to test out. She takes her job very seriously and is always doing her housework and generally looking after Hiroki. Even though she’s a robot, Alicia doesn’t act like it and is very warm-hearted.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/09/01/otome-kairo-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
